ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: A Local Project for Mapping Urban Forests

fullPassage:
The researchers participating in the Montreal Tree Project asked residents and public institutions around Concordia University for help. The researchers asked them to photograph the bark and leaves of the trees on their properties and submit the photos to the project's website for analysis. The project is now complete, and they say the results show the importance of having a diverse tree population in a city.
Trees on private lands were found to be more diverse than those on public lands. The two groups of trees served different purposes, too. Trees on private lands served functions such as providing fruit, flowers, or beauty, and those on public lands provided shade, regulated temperature, and fought air pollution.
Hutt-Taylor, one of the researchers, says that diversity of trees can make a forest more adaptable to events like climate change. For residents who want to plant trees on their own lands, she suggests they choose trees that are both native to their regions and are of a different species from their neighbors' trees.

questions.passage: The researchers ①<u>participating</u> in the Montreal Tree Project asked residents and public institutions around Concordia University for help. The researchers asked them ②<u>to photograph</u> the bark and leaves of the trees on their properties and ③<u>submit</u> the photos to the project's website for ④<u>analyze</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ①participating: 현재분사, researchers 수식. ✅ ②to photograph: asked + O + to V. ✅ ③submit: and로 to photograph와 병렬(to가 생략됨). ❌ ④analyze: 전치사 for 뒤에 동사 원형 불가. for analysis(명사)가 맞음.
det.tip: for + 명사 (O) / for + 동사원형 (X). for analysis = 분석을 위해.

questions.passage: Trees on private lands were found to be more diverse than ①<u>those</u> on public lands. The two groups of trees served different purposes, too. Trees on private lands served functions such as ②<u>providing</u> fruit, flowers, or beauty, and those on public lands ③<u>provided</u> shade, regulated temperature, and ④<u>fighting</u> air pollution.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 그늘을 제공하고, 온도를 조절하고, 대기 오염과 싸웠다(fought).
det.analysis: ✅ ①those: trees를 대신하는 지시대명사. ✅ ②providing: such as + V-ing. ✅ ③provided: 과거형, 주어 those에 맞음. ❌ ④fighting: provided, regulated와 병렬이므로 과거형 fought가 맞음.
det.tip: 병렬 구조: provided A, regulated B, and fought C. 과거형 통일.

questions.passage: Hutt-Taylor, one of the researchers, says that diversity of trees can ①<u>make</u> a forest more adaptable to events like climate change. For residents ②<u>who</u> want to plant trees on their own lands, she suggests they ③<u>choose</u> trees that are both native to their regions and ④<u>is</u> of a different species from their neighbors' trees.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ①make: can + V(원형). ✅ ②who: residents(사람) 수식 관계대명사. ✅ ③choose: suggest + (that) S + V(원형). ❌ ④is: 주어 trees(복수)이므로 are가 맞음. both A and B 구문에서 are native와 are of 병렬.
det.tip: both A and B: 복수 취급. trees that are both native ... and are of ...

questions.passage: The project is now complete, and they say the results ①<u>show</u> the importance of ②<u>having</u> a diverse tree population in a city. Trees on private lands were ③<u>found</u> to be more diverse than those on public lands. The two groups of trees ④<u>serving</u> different purposes, too.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ①show: 복수 주어 results에 맞음. ✅ ②having: of + V-ing. ✅ ③found: were found(수동태). ❌ ④serving: 주어(groups) + 동사 자리이므로 served(과거)가 맞음. 현재분사 serving은 동사 역할 불가.
det.tip: 주어 + 동사(서술어) 자리. The groups served (O) / The groups serving (X).

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오: '연구자들은 주민들에게 나무의 껍질과 잎을 촬영해 달라고 요청했다.'

det.korean: 연구자들이 나무 껍질과 잎 촬영을 요청한 것은 원문과 일치.
det.analysis: ✅ T: 'asked them to photograph the bark and leaves of the trees' — 껍질(bark)과 잎(leaves)을 촬영해 달라고 요청.
det.tip: bark: 나무 껍질. leaves: 잎.

questions.passage: Trees on private lands were found to be more diverse than those on public lands. The two groups of trees served different purposes, too. Trees on private lands served functions such as providing fruit, flowers, or beauty, and those on public lands provided shade, regulated temperature, and fought air pollution.

det.analysis: ❌ F: 원문은 'Trees on private lands were found to be more diverse than those on public lands.' 사유지 > 공유지.
det.tip: private lands(사유지)의 나무가 public lands(공유지)보다 more diverse.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ②importance: 프로젝트 결과가 보여주는 것 = 다양성의 중요성. ❌ ①obstacle(장애물): 맥락 반대. ❌ ③decline(감소): 무관. ❌ ④absence(부재): 무관.
det.tip: importance: 중요성. show the importance of = ~의 중요성을 보여주다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ④neighbors' trees: 이웃의 나무와 다른 종 선택. ❌ ①②③: 원문과 불일치.
det.tip: a different species from their neighbors' trees = 이웃 나무와 다른 종. 다양성 확보 전략.

questions.passage: Trees on private lands were found to be more diverse than those on public lands. The two groups of trees served different purposes, too. Trees on private lands served functions such as providing fruit, flowers, or beauty, and those on public lands provided shade, regulated temperature, and fought air pollution.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 공유지(public lands)의 나무가 수행하는 기능이 아닌 것은?

det.korean: 과일/꽃은 사유지 나무의 기능. 공유지 나무는 그늘/온도조절/대기오염 방지.
det.analysis: ✅ ①: providing fruit, flowers는 private lands의 기능. ❌ ②③④: public lands의 기능에 해당.
det.tip: private: 과일, 꽃, 아름다움. public: 그늘, 온도조절, 대기오염 퇴치.

questions.passage: Hutt-Taylor, one of the researchers, says that diversity of trees can make a forest more adaptable to events like climate change. For residents who want to plant trees on their own lands, she suggests they choose trees that are both native to their regions and are of a different species from their neighbors' trees.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 Hutt-Taylor의 주장으로 적절하지 않은 것은?
ch: 나무의 다양성이 숲을 기후변화에 더 잘 적응하게 한다
이웃과 같은 종의 나무를 심을 것을 권장한다
지역 토착 나무를 선택할 것을 제안한다
나무를 심고 싶은 주민에게 조언을 한다

det.korean: 이웃과 다른 종의 나무를 심으라고 했지, 같은 종이 아님.
det.analysis: ❌ ③: 원문은 'a different species from their neighbors' trees' = 이웃과 다른 종. '같은 종'은 반대. ✅ ①②④: 원문 일치.
det.tip: different species from = ~와 다른 종. 다양성 확보 목적.

questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 쓰시오.

det.analysis: properties: 소유지. on their properties = 그들의 소유지에 있는.
det.tip: property: 재산, 소유지, 부동산. 복수형 properties.

questions.passage: The researchers participating in the Montreal Tree Project asked residents and public institutions around Concordia University for help. questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 쓰시오.

det.korean: 공유지 나무는 그늘, 온도 조절, 대기오염 퇴치 기능.
det.analysis: temperature: 온도. regulated temperature = 온도를 조절했다.
det.tip: temperature: 온도, 기온. regulate temperature = 온도를 조절하다.

questions.stem: 주어진 문장이 들어갈 위치로 가장 적절한 곳은? "In other words, variety among trees in urban areas matters greatly."

det.korean: '다양성이 중요하다'를 보여주는 결과 다음, 사유지/공유지 비교 전에 삽입.
det.analysis:
❌ ① ①
❌ ② ②
✅ ③ ③
❌ ④ ④
✅ ③: 앞 문장에서 diverse tree population의 중요성 언급 → 삽입 문장이 'In other words'로 부연 → 이후 구체적 비교.
det.tip: In other words: 다시 말해. 앞 문장의 핵심을 부연하는 위치.

questions.stem:
주어진 문장 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
(A) She suggests they choose trees that are both native to their regions and are of a different species from their neighbors' trees.
(B) For residents who want to plant trees on their own lands, she has specific advice.
(C) This way, the variety of tree species in the area will naturally increase.

det.korean: 기후변화 적응 언급 → (B) 조언이 있다 → (A) 구체적 제안 → (C) 결과적으로 다양성 증가.
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)-(C)-(B)
✅ ② (B)-(A)-(C)
❌ ③ (C)-(A)-(B)
❌ ④ (C)-(B)-(A)
✅ (B)-(A)-(C): (B) 조언 예고 → (A) 토착종+다른 종 선택 → (C) 다양성 증가 결과.
det.tip: (B) specific advice 예고 → (A) 구체적 내용 → (C) 결과.

questions.passage: The researchers participating in the Montreal Tree Project asked residents and public institutions around Concordia University for help. The researchers asked them to photograph the bark and leaves of the trees on their properties and submit the photos to the project's website for analysis. The project is now complete, and <u>they</u> say the results show the importance of having a diverse tree population in a city. Trees on private lands were found to be more diverse than those on public lands. The two groups of trees served different purposes, too.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>they</u>가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 프로젝트 완료 후 결과를 말하는 주체 = 연구자들.
det.analysis:
✅ ① the researchers
❌ ② the residents
❌ ③ the trees
❌ ④ public institutions
✅ ①the researchers: 프로젝트를 수행하고 결과를 발표하는 주체. they say the results show → 연구자들이 말한다.
det.tip: they = 앞에서 주도적으로 행동하는 주체. 여기서는 researchers.

questions.passage: The project is now complete, and they say the results show the importance of having a diverse tree population in a city. Trees on private lands were found to be more diverse than those on public lands. The two groups of trees served different purposes, too. Trees on private lands served functions such as providing fruit, flowers, or beauty, and <u>those</u> on public lands provided shade, regulated temperature, and fought air pollution. Hutt-Taylor says that diversity of trees can make a forest more adaptable to events like climate change.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>those</u>가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 공유지의 나무들. those = trees (사유지 나무와 대비되는 공유지 나무).
det.analysis:
❌ ① residents
✅ ② trees
❌ ③ functions
❌ ④ purposes
✅ ②trees: those on public lands = trees on public lands. trees를 반복 대용.
det.tip: those = 앞에 나온 복수 명사 대용. Trees on private lands ... and those on public lands.

questions.passage: The project is now complete, and they say the results show the importance of having a diverse tree population in a city. Trees on private lands were found to be more diverse than those on public lands. The two groups of trees served different purposes, (__________). Trees on private lands served functions such as providing fruit, flowers, or beauty, and those on public lands provided shade, regulated temperature, and fought air pollution.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 연결사로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ②too: 다양성뿐 아니라 목적도(도) 달랐다. 추가 정보. ❌ ①however(그러나): 역접 아님. ❌ ③therefore(따라서): 인과 아님. ❌ ④instead(대신): 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: too: ~도. 앞 문장(다양성 차이)에 추가로 목적 차이 언급.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.
'연구자들은 주민들에게 도움을 요청했다.'

det.tip: ask A for B: A에게 B를 요청하다.
